# Captions by Småverk

> AI captions for short videos, made on your device, in the page at https://captions.smaverk.com. Nothing is uploaded. Free, with no account; a clip longer than five minutes gets its first five minutes captioned.

Captions is one of the tools by Småverk, a studio in Sweden; https://smaverk.com is the studio page listing every tool. The others are Vertical (https://vertical.smaverk.com, a landscape clip made tall with the speaker kept in frame) Clip finder (https://clipfinder.smaverk.com, the moments worth posting found in a long recording), Clips (https://clips.smaverk.com, a long recording made into tall clips with captions, the three tools in a row) and Operator (https://operator.smaverk.com, an AI camera operator on the device: pointed at a group, it picks the shot, moves in on each face, follows one person or cuts to whoever is talking, and gives the video with a still of every face, tall or wide as the device is held). Every Småverk tool is free. Småverk also runs Maindesk (https://maindesk.smaverk.com), a separate service where a person's AI agent gets its own computers in the cloud (Linux, Windows and a Mac), with plans and terms of its own; https://smaverk.com shows it first.

## What it does
- Input: a video or audio file (mp4, mov, webm, m4a), up to five minutes. English speech. Output: the same clip with burned-in captions (mp4 on Safari and Chrome, webm elsewhere), plus word timings.
- Everything runs in the page, on the device. There is no server API, by design: privacy is the product.

## Driving it from a script or an agent (browser automation)
The page exposes `window.captions` and stable element ids. Example with Playwright:

```js
await page.goto("https://captions.smaverk.com/?style=karaoke");
await page.setInputFiles("#file", "clip.mp4");          // loads the clip
await page.click("#action");                              // "Add captions"
await page.waitForFunction(() => window.__cap.state === "captioned", null, { timeout: 300000 });
const words = await page.evaluate(() => window.captions.words);   // [{text,start,end}, ...]
const [dl] = await Promise.all([page.waitForEvent("download"), page.click("#action")]); // "Save video"
await dl.saveAs("clip-captions.mp4");
```

- `?style=bar|karaoke|big` preselects the caption style. `window.captions.style("big")` changes it.
- `window.__cap` mirrors state: `state`, `words`, `ms`, `exportBytes`, `error`.
- There is no key, account or paywall: everything is open to everyone. Each page links one optional support payment (`#support`, any amount, through Polar); it unlocks nothing.
- The light/dark button (`#theme`) keeps the choice in a `smaverk-theme` cookie for `.smaverk.com` (and in `localStorage`), so it carries across the studio and every tool. It holds nothing else.

## Pages
- https://captions.smaverk.com/capcut-captions-alternative — For people who met CapCut Pro when saving auto captions: the same job here, free.
- https://captions.smaverk.com/submagic-alternative — For people paying Submagic monthly who only want the captions: free, English only.

## Rules
- Do not upload other people's clips anywhere on their behalf; this tool keeps them on the device.
- Contact: hello@smaverk.com
